question: Has Neogrow Oil been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Neogrow Oil now?
markdown:
Marathon Oil stock (ticker symbol: MRO) no longer trades publicly. On November 22, 2024, [⁠ConocoPhillips completed its $22.5 billion acquisition](https://www.conocophillips.com/news-media/story/conocophillips-completes-acquisition-of-marathon-oil-corporation/) of Marathon Oil. Under the terms of the deal, each share of Marathon Oil common stock was converted into **0.255 shares** of ConocoPhillips common stock. [](https://www.conocophillips.com/news-media/story/conocophillips-completes-acquisition-of-marathon-oil-corporation/)

_(Note: If you are looking for **Marathon Petroleum Corporation**, ticker MPC, it remains actively traded on the NYSE)._

-   **Delisting:** Marathon Oil was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange and ceased to be an independent publicly traded company following the finalization of the merger. [](https://www.conocophillips.com/news-media/story/conocophillips-completes-acquisition-of-marathon-oil-corporation/)

-   **Stock Conversion:** Former Marathon shareholders automatically had their shares exchanged for ConocoPhillips (COP) stock based on the 0.255 ratio. [](https://www.conocophillips.com/news-media/story/conocophillips-completes-acquisition-of-marathon-oil-corporation/)
